purpose: React to an unexpected fact with surprise or strong feeling.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause / N（だ / だった）+ とは
I was surprised to meet you again in a place like this.
To think that tiny seedling would grow this much!
I cannot believe they are only ten.
formation: Plain clause / N（だ / だった）+ とは
restrictions: The emotional conclusion can be spoken or left implicit.
mistake: This entry emphasizes surprise; definition-making とは is a separate use.
